$comment: Authored (WP-F; revised for D-013 Q-06). Three disjoint groups, each enforced exactly by `tokens:check` (checkProvisional): (1) `provisional`: no Tecton decision, values are proposals (D-002; data-viz stays a proposed mapping from palette colours, D-013); (2) `retainedDefault`: not brand tokens, Tecton has none, so the upstream values are kept on purpose (motion, breakpoints, z-index; D-013 Q-06); (3) `tectonDerived`: settled by D-013 Q-06 as Tecton-derived, never provisional (headings 3-6, letter-spacing, the destructive button). `nonTokens` items have no custom property; they are exported from tokens.js / tokens.json and listed on the docs' 'Differences and open items' page. The pipeline-defined extras (extra-tokens.json) are provisional too.

categories.reason: Data-viz colours: Tecton documents none. Proposed mapping from Tecton accent hues and status roles, palette colours only (D-013 Q-06): the accent fill stops (categorical) and the onLight ramp (sequential); the teal/brown/indigo slots borrow lime/yellow/orchid (docs/research/tecton-theme.md 3.8).

names.name: --size-element-lg
names.reason: Control height 36px has no Tecton source (Tecton names only sm 28 and md 32); the upstream value is kept.

nonTokens.name: icons: chevronsLeft, chevronsRight, calendar, clock, checkDouble, stop
nonTokens.reason: Six roles without a Tecton glyph; covered by the Lucide default set (D-009, D-013 Q-02).

categories.reason: Motion is not a brand token and Tecton has none: the upstream durations and easing are kept on purpose (D-013 Q-06).

nonTokens.name: breakpoints
nonTokens.reason: sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536: upstream DEFAULT_WIDTH_BREAKPOINTS, kept on purpose (not a brand token, Tecton has none; D-013 Q-06). Exported from tokens.js / tokens.json (not custom properties: they cannot be used in media queries).

nonTokens.name: z-index
nonTokens.reason: Upstream defines no z-index tokens; overlays use the top layer, and the few hard-coded upstream layers (Toast 500, BottomSheet 1000, skip link 9999) are kept on purpose (D-013 Q-06). Nothing to map.

names.name: --text-heading-3-leading
names.reason: Heading 3 is Tecton's `large` (line height 20px), D-013 Q-06.

names.name: --text-heading-4-weight
names.reason: Heading 4 keeps the heading weight 500 on Tecton's `medium` size (14px); the `medium` body variant itself is 400. D-013 Q-06.

names.name: --text-heading-4-leading
names.reason: Heading 4 is Tecton's `medium` (line height 18px), D-013 Q-06.

names.name: --text-heading-5-weight
names.reason: Heading 5 keeps the heading weight 500 on Tecton's `small` size (12px); the `small` body variant itself is 400. D-013 Q-06.

names.name: --text-heading-5-leading
names.reason: Heading 5 is Tecton's `small` (line height 16px), D-013 Q-06.

names.name: --text-heading-6-leading
names.reason: Heading 6 is Tecton's `tiny` (line height 14px), D-013 Q-06.

nonTokens.name: letter-spacing
nonTokens.reason: Tecton specifies no letter-spacing anywhere (design/components/button.md, the export, the Tecton binding), so it resolves to `normal` for every text style; upstream has no tracking tokens either (D-013 Q-06). tokens:check asserts every typography variant in the semantic map says `normal`.

nonTokens.name: destructive button
nonTokens.reason: Tecton has no destructive button. The upstream `destructive` variant is kept and styled only from Tecton --tecton-color-status-error-* roles (D-013 Q-06): filled roles for the button, outline roles where it sits on a ghost/tertiary surface. The disabled state uses the shared Tecton disabled roles, and the focus ring stays hot pink (D-005). The component layer reads these roles directly; no extra tokens are needed.
